'''2018 European MPC Results Ulli Reuter LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ulli Reuter]] at [[2018 European Match Play Championship]] (Results).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Ulli Reuter]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 European Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We Have A Plan|Theed-L-wehaveaplan.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open We Have A Plan Reuter LS 2018 MPC.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-european-match-play-championships/ PC list]
